Passed a) Click on Viewer options in Work area to Verify the Displayed Units . Optional: b) select the requirement type of Units as Meters (M) from the Displayed dropdown list. Passed Enable Arc Centers and Select any two Arc points of parts to measure the Arc length Optional: Click on Delete->Selected/All in Measurement Tool bar to remove above Measurements in 3D view. Expected Result Arc length between selected points will be displayed 10. Passed a) Click on Markups to Highlight information and select Mark, Circle, Text in 3D Tab for reference. b) Click on Capture Snapshot to save the Image with markups. Expected Result Highlighted information on structure will be saved to Gallery . 11. Passed Click on Delete in the work area tool bar to delete any Markups Expected Result Markups added in the 3D visualization will be deleted. 12. Passed Click on Gallery to view all the snaps captured of Assembly structure Note: User can change Snapshot Source Preferences to View other Snaps shared to them. Expected Result All Captured screenshots will be available in Gallery 13. Passed a) Navigate to Home screen, Click on My Gallery to view all the captured screenshots from Visualization. b) Select a Snap under Created by me and Click ... (Options)->Created Discussion. Result Title 1. Passed Pre- Requisite: a) All required Reuse Library Parts should be available in in Reuse Library folder . b) User should have access to same Project access as in below mentioned Test data. 2. Passed Switch to Integrated Active Workspace from NX Expected Result User is now in AW 5. Passed Search & Open any Part/Assembly revision by Providing the Part Number in Global Search. Note:- Make sure Part/Assembly should have UGMASTER Data Set already present , if it is not present then add from NX by ""Clone Start Part"" Addon Expected Result Part/Assembly revision is search and open in PLATON. 6. Passed CASE 1:- Add Sub-Parts to assembly in PLATON Select the Assembly top node & click Add->Child button Expected Result Add Child dialogue appears 7. Passed Click on N ew to add newly created Component/sub-parts OR Click on Palette to add already copied the existing Component/sub-parts OR Click on Search to add if user wants to search the existing Component/sub-parts Note:- Try to add multiple revisions of the same geometry under a parent in an assembly. Multiple revisions of the same Geometry should not be allowed under a parent in an assembly. Expected Result Sub-part child is added successfully to the assembly 8. Passed Repeat step 3 and 4 to add some more sub-parts. Note:- This step is optional, if require execute. Expected Result Sub-part child is added successfully to the assembly 9. Passed CASE 2:- Remove Sub-Parts to assembly in PLATON a. Select the component/sub-part which needs to be remove from assembly & click Edit Structure-> Remove b. Click Remove to remove the sub-parts Expected Result Component/sub-parts is successfully removed from the Structure 10. Passed Repeat step 6 to remove some more sub-parts as per requirement. Note:- This step is optional, if require execute. Expected Result Component/sub-parts is successfully removed from the Structure 11. Passed CASE 3:- Replace Sub-Parts to assembly in PLATON a. Select the sub-part which needs to be replace from assembly & click Edit Structure-> Replace Expected Result Replace dialogue appears. 12. Passed a. Click on New to replace newly created Component/Sub-parts OR Click on Palette to replace already copied the existing Component/sub-parts OR Click on Search if user wants to search the existing Component/ sub-parts b. After selecting any one of the above option, click Replace button Expected Result The required child sub-parts is replaced successfully. 13. Passed Select the structure -> Click on Open in NX icon to open the Design / Component directly in NX. Expected Result Part/Assembly is open in NX. 14. Passed Select the top Assembly Structure & switch to Assemblies tab. Expected Result User is on Assembly tab. 15. Passed CASE 1:- Add New Parts/components to assembly a. Click on New Component button b. Select Template as Modeling c. In Name & Attributes select Item Type as Geometry d. Provide required information in Name & Attributes Section by double clicking in the Value field e. Select appropriate Folder and then click OK button Expected Result Part/Geometry object is created under Assembly structure successfully. 16. Passed CASE 2:- Add existing Parts/components to assembly a. Select the top node and Switch to Integrated Active Workspace in NX b . Search any Parts/components revision by Providing the Part Number in Global Search. c. Select the searched Parts/components and go to primary tool bar NX>Add d . In Add Component dialogue click on OK Expected Result User is now in Integrated Active Workspace. Parts/components revision is search and open in Integrated AWC. Add Component dialogue opens Parts/components is added successfully under Assembly structure. 17. Passed CASE 3:- Remove Parts /components from assembly Select the component/sub-part which needs to be remove from assembly do right mouse button-> Delete Expected Result The required component/part is successfully removed. 18. Passed CASE 4:- Replace with Parts /components in assembly a. Select the component/part to be replaced from Assembly & right mouse button-> Replace Component... b. Go to Browse section & click Open button c. In Search section, click on Advanced Search button d. Select DT_Part_Number Query from Define search>look for & enter Part Number, select Owner name if you know or keep blank and click on Find Now. & find the required Component for Replacement then hit OK Expected Result Replace Component dialogue appeared. Part File Name dialogue appeared. Advanced Search dialogue opened. The required child line is replaced successfully 19. Passed Click on the File>save . Expected Result Assembly saved successfully. 20. Passed Select top node of assembly and make it as work part Expected Result Assembly is set for work part. 21. None Case : Add member from ""Reuse Library"" a. Click on ""Reuse Library"" in Resource bar b. Go to Folder View section to select QGDJ_HC35_clash_Henn by navigating the path : PLATON Daimler Truck Libraries-->MechanicalRouting-->16_0_Henn_clashes c. Go to ""Member Select"" section. d. Select QGDJ_HC35_clash_Henn. e. Do Right click->Add to Assembly or drag and drop to add. f. Select the required parameters and placement details as per the requirement. Click Ok to add it to Assembly. Expected Result Selected QGDJ_HC35_clash_Henn from Library is added to assembly workpart. 22. Passed Case : Add UDF member from Reuse Lib... a . Click on ""Reuse Library"" in Resource bar b. Go to Folder View section c. Navigating the path : Native Daimler Truck Libraries—>3D-Master->3D-Master UDFs. c. Go to ""Member Select"" section. d. Select any UDF and add . e. Do Right click-> Insert to Assembly OR drag and drop to Display Tab to add it to Assembly as per requirement Expected Result Selected UDF from Library is added to assembly workpart. 23. None Case: Add a Stock to the Routing a. Go to Application->Mechanical Route application. b. Go to Home and create any spline path or any. c. Navigating the path for ""Reuse Library""-> Folder View -> Routing Part Libraries->Tubing Stock"" then add any stock from ""Member Select"" section. Expected Result Stock will is added to structure successfully 24. Passed Save the assembly by File ->Save ->Save work part . Check-in Assembly. Expected Result Assembly is saved and checked in. Note: This step is not applicable to TN (DTNA). Expected Result a) Find Panel will be displayed. b) Results will displayed Parts. c, d) Product structure/Product revision will be configured as per Milestone linkage. 13. Passed a) Navigate to Revision Rule in Header section and Select a Rule from the list. b) Enter the Part number in Find section and Click on Search . Expected Result a) Product Structure/Product revision will be configured as per revision rule applied. b) Results will display Parts. 14. Passed a) Select the required Component/Part revision from the results or structure and Click on Copy on Tool bar. b) Switch to Workset browser tab, Select the Workset revision and click on Add->Child in Content table header section. (or) Optional - Alternate way: Component/Part revision will be added as a Child to the Workset revision. 15. Passed a) Navigate to palette section, Select the Component/Part assembly revision available and then Click on Add. b) Click on Replay command available on Work area Tool bar to update Workset with latest filters and Configurations. Expected Result a) Component/Part Assy revision will be added as a child to Workset. b) All assemblies under Workset will be updated with latest filters and Configurations. 16. Passed Switch to 3D view in work area and Enable the newly added revision. Expected Result Selected Assembly/Part structure will be displayed in 3D view. 17. Passed a) Select the Workset revision and Click on Add->Child on Header section. b) Navigate to search section, Search for Assembly structure ( Ex: Product structure/Product revision/Part revision/Component revision) with Part number. c) Select the Part/Assy structure with appropriate revision ID and Click on Add. Expected Result a) Add panel will be displayed. b) Assy structure will be found in results. c) Assy structure revision will be added as child to Workset. 18. Passed Click on Replay command available on Work area Tool bar to update Workset with latest filters and Configurations. Expected Result All assemblies under Workset will be updated with latest filters and Configurations. 19. Passed a) Enable the Workset revision/Top Node in the Content table. b) Enable/Disable each structure under Workset to view individual assemblies. Expected Result a) Structure configured in Workset will be displayed in 3D viewer. b) Assemblies will be displayed as selected in Content table. Step 6 .: The line is missing : ""Change to Data manager"" as rolle, only DATA managers have the right to change / revise a SA revision. Wrong description. Step 7 : there is no ""Content Tab"" for a SA revision (for example Z537164). STep 8 : Error message on step 8b, The selected Product strucutre doens´t have any configurato context object associated. How shall i do this ? Step no. Result Title 1. Passed Pre- Requisite: a) User should have access to same Project access as in below mentioned Test data. b) ZGS should not be incremented for the solution Items. c) Predecessor revisions of SA/Component with necessary attributes in Component usage table should be released in Safira previously. 2. Passed TEST DATA: BuSc 22.03: TT: DMH47X CTT: USC_136_J_MBMO TE: ARR01090696, ARR01178194 3. Passed Login to Teamcenter with valid credentials Example: Group: TT/DICV/CTT/TE Role: PDM-Author Expected Result Homepage will be displayed on successful login 4. Passed Search and Open Stoppage ECO revision with Part revisions added as Solution Items. Expected Result ECO revision is found successfully 5. Passed a) Select the Solution Item and Click on Open->Open in New tab on Tool bar. b) Navigate to Whereused Tab on Part revision to find the reference of assemblies in Used in structures table. c) Select the Component revision in Used in structures table and Click on Expand (>) to View BoM Structure. Expected Result a) Part revision will be opened. b) Used in structures table will show the assemblies or components where this Part is used. c) Component revision will show the BoM level of structure. Comments: The ""solution item must be a z-component"", the sentence is missing "" inside affected items, go to solution items"", and then where used tab. where are the pictures ? then you use the right mouse for the open in new tab. The description is incomplete. 6. Passed Referenced Assemblies in Released state a) Select Released SA revision in above BoM Structure of Component revision and Click on Open->Open in New tab on Primary Toolbar. b) Select the Released SA revision and Click on New->Revise to create a working revision. Note: SA/Component revision where the Stop part is having occurrence Expected Result a) SA revision will be opened successfully. b) New revision will be created for the Released revision. Comments: The line is missing : ""Change to Data manager"" as role, and say ""Edit"", only DATA managers have the right to change / revise a SA revision. Wrong description. 7. Passed a) Navigate to Content tab of SA revision or Assembly structure. b) Navigate to Revision Rule and select ""Latest working"" to view the above working revision in the structure. Expected Result a) Content tab will display BoM structure. b) Working revisions will be loaded in the structure. Comments: there is no ""Content Tab"" for a SA revision (for example Z537164). This is a wrong description. 8. Failed a) Select the Working SA revision and Navigate to Component usage table in the Work area. b) Click on Check-Out and Update the Maturity level with ""S"" for all usages available for the SA revision. c) Click on "" Save Edits -> Check-In"" (or) "" Save And Check In"" at the Component usage table. Expected Result a) All usages of the selected SA/Component will be available in table. b, c) Maturity level is updated for all the usages of SA and Component revisions. Comments: Error message on step 8b, The selected Product strucutre doens´t have any configurato context object associated. How shall i do this ? 9. None a) Navigate to the Part revision (A-Part/Stop part) in the BoM Table and Click on Edit at the Header section. b) Navigate to Maturity Status column and Update as ""S"" then Click on Save Edits. Expected Result a) Editable attributes will be enabled in the BoM table. b) Maturity level is updated for Stop part in the BoM table. 10. None Select the SA & Component/Assembly revisions which have the occurrence of Stop Part and Click on Copy on Primary tool bar. Expected Result Selected Component/Assemblies will be added to Solution Items folder. 11. None a) Open Stoppage ECO Revision and Navigate to Solution Items in Overview page. b) Click on Add and Select the SA revision in Clipboard on palette. c) Click on Add. Expected Result a) Stoppage ECO is opened. b) Add panel will be displayed. c) SA revision will be added to Solution Items. 12. None a) Open Stoppage ECO Revision and Navigate to Solution Items in Overview page. b) Click on Add and Select the Component revision in Clipboard on palette. c) click on Next in Add Panel. d) Click on Add command. Expected Result a) Secondary references will be visible for all Solution Items added. b, c ) ZGS and Type of Change as ""A"" attributes will be displayed for the selected Released Part revision. d) Component revision will be added to Solution Items of Stoppage ECO revision. 13. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the SA revision and Click on More options->Manage->Platon Validation. b) Select the SA revision in the Solution Items and and Click on Open. c) Navigate to Platon validation tab & Under Validation Result Table, Verify the values under validation status column should be OK/Not Relevant. d) Verify Engineering Ready & also Pre- Release status . Note: If any of the check is Not Ok complete the respective check as per Action Item Column & Repeat step 14. Expected Result a) Platon validation checks will be performed on SA revision. b) SA revision will be opened. c) All Validation Results are verified successfully. d) Engineering Ready is Set to True and Pre-release status is Set to Success . 14. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the SA revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Submit to workflow. b) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. c) Navigate to Overview tab and verify the Release status of SA revision. Expected Result a) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. c) Engineering State should be assigned to the SA revision. 15. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the Component revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Platon Validation. b) Select the Component revision in the Solution Items and and Click on Open. c) Navigate to Platon validation tab & Under Validation Result Table, Verify the values under validation status column should be OK/Not Relevant. d) Verify Engineering Ready & also Pre- Release status . Note: If any of the check is Not Ok complete the respective check as per Action Item Column & Repeat step 16. Expected Result a) Platon validation checks will be performed on Component revision. b) Component revision will be opened. c) All Validation Results are verified successfully. d) Engineering Ready is Set to True and Pre-release status is Set to Success . 16. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the Component revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Submit to workflow. b) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. c) Navigate to Overview tab and verify the Release status of Component revision. Expected Result a) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. c) Engineering State should be assigned to the Component revision. 17. None Optional: Alternate way to Initiate Wf on Multiple Items at once a) Navigate to Solution Items and Click on Selection mode . b) Select the SA and Component revisions in the Solution Items. b) Click on More options->Manage->Submit to workflow. c) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. Expected Result a) Selection option will be enabled for Solution Items. b) SA & Component revisions will be selected. c) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. 18. None Optional: Continuation to step 18 a) Open SA revision and verify Release status in Overview tab. b) Open Component Revision, verify Release status in Overview tab. Expected Result Engineering State should be assigned to the SA/Component revision. 19. None Repeat steps 05-17 for all the Referenced assemblies of the A-Part where it has to be stopped. 422642,"Submitting SA revision to workflow fails,","Copied from Repro Steps when changed from Bug to Platon Incident 05.09.2025 09:43 Bug filed on ""22.03_BuSc [181869] - Update Maturity Level of Stop Parts in Bom Table and its Referenced Assemblies (Released) in Component usage table"" Step no. Result Title 1. Passed Pre- Requisite: a) User should have access to same Project access as in below mentioned Test data. b) ZGS should not be incremented for the solution Items. c) Predecessor revisions of SA/Component with necessary attributes in Component usage table should be released in Safira previously. 2. Passed TEST DATA: BuSc 22.03: TT: DMH47X CTT: USC_136_J_MBMO TE: ARR01090696, ARR01178194 3. Passed Login to Teamcenter with valid credentials Example: Group: TT/DICV/CTT/TE Role: PDM-Author Expected Result Homepage will be displayed on successful login 4. Passed Search and Open Stoppage ECO revision with Part revisions added as Solution Items. Expected Result ECO revision is found successfully Comment : we use ECO ZSX1025 5. Passed a) Select the Released Part revision in Solution Items under Affected Items and Click on Open->Open in New tab on Tool bar. b) Navigate to Whereused Tab on Part revision to find the reference of assemblies in Used in structures table. c) Select the Component revision in Used in structures table and Click on Expand (>) to View BoM Structure. Expected Result a) Part revision will be opened. b) Used in structures table will show the assemblies or components where this Part is used. c) Component revision will show the BoM level of structure. We use Part A740 2215 701, Component revision Z53718116, SA revision Z563718116. 6. Passed Referenced Assemblies in Released state a) Select Released SA revision in above BoM Structure of Component revision and Click on Open->Open in New tab on Primary Toolbar. b) Select the Released SA revision and Click on New->Revise to create a working revision. Note: SA/Component revision where the Stop part is having occurrence Expected Result a) SA revision will be opened successfully. b) New revision will be created for the Released revision. 7. Passed a) Navigate to Content tab of SA revision or Assembly structure. b) Navigate to Revision Rule and select ""Latest working"" to view the above working revision in the structure. Expected Result a) Content tab will display BoM structure. b) Working revisions will be loaded in the structure. 8. Passed a) Select the Working SA revision and Navigate to Component usage table in the Work area. b) Click on Check-Out and Update the Maturity level with ""S"" for all usages available for the SA revision. c) Click on "" Save Edits -> Check-In"" (or) "" Save And Check In"" at the Component usage table. SAVE EDITS Worked. Expected Result a) All usages of the selected SA/Component will be available in table. b, c) Maturity level is updated for all the usages of SA and Component revisions. 9. Passed a) Navigate to the Part revision (A-Part/Stop part) in the BoM Table and Click on Edit at the Header section. b) Navigate to Maturity Status column and Update as ""S"" then Click on Save Edits. Expected Result a) Editable attributes will be enabled in the BoM table. b) Maturity level is updated for Stop part in the BoM table. 10. Passed Select the SA & Component/Assembly revisions which have the occurrence of Stop Part and Click on Copy on Primary tool bar. Expected Result Selected Component/Assemblies will be added to Solution Items folder. 11. Passed a) Open Stoppage ECO Revision and Navigate to Solution Items in Overview page. b) Click on Add and Select the SA revision in Clipboard on palette. c) Click on Add. Expected Result a) Stoppage ECO is opened. b) Add panel will be displayed. c) SA revision will be added to Solution Items. this worked : 12. Passed a) Open Stoppage ECO Revision and Navigate to Solution Items in Overview page. b) Click on Add and Select the Component revision in Clipboard on palette. c) click on Next in Add Panel. d) Click on Add command. Expected Result a) Secondary references will be visible for all Solution Items added. b, c ) ZGS and Type of Change as ""A"" attributes will be displayed for the selected Released Part revision. d) Component revision will be added to Solution Items of Stoppage ECO revision. This worked. 13. Passed a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the SA revision and Click on More options->Manage->Platon Validation. b) Select the SA revision in the Solution Items and and Click on Open. c) Navigate to Platon validation tab & Under Validation Result Table, Verify the values under validation status column should be OK/Not Relevant. d) Verify Engineering Ready & also Pre- Release status . Note: If any of the check is Not Ok complete the respective check as per Action Item Column & Repeat step 14. This worked : Expected Result a) Platon validation checks will be performed on SA revision. b) SA revision will be opened. c) All Validation Results are verified successfully. d) Engineering Ready is Set to True and Pre-release status is Set to Success . 14. Failed a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the SA revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Submit to workflow. b) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. DONE And then : There is a submenu missing you cannot push the button submit ! The submenu where to select the type of workflow is shown half a second and disappears. No further action possible ! c) Navigate to Overview tab and verify the Release status of SA revision. Expected Result a) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. c) Engineering State should be assigned to the SA revision. Comments: Look, here the SA revision cannot be submitted. You open the submit window and then inside the window there is no menu for selecting ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" , so you can´t proceed. 15. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the Component revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Platon Validation. b) Select the Component revision in the Solution Items and and Click on Open. c) Navigate to Platon validation tab & Under Validation Result Table, Verify the values under validation status column should be OK/Not Relevant. d) Verify Engineering Ready & also Pre- Release status . Note: If any of the check is Not Ok complete the respective check as per Action Item Column & Repeat step 16. Expected Result a) Platon validation checks will be performed on Component revision. b) Component revision will be opened. c) All Validation Results are verified successfully. d) Engineering Ready is Set to True and Pre-release status is Set to Success . 16. None a) Navigate to Solution Items table, Select the Component revision and Click on More commands->Manage->Submit to workflow. b) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. c) Navigate to Overview tab and verify the Release status of Component revision. Expected Result a) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. c) Engineering State should be assigned to the Component revision. 17. None Optional: Alternate way to Initiate Wf on Multiple Items at once a) Navigate to Solution Items and Click on Selection mode . b) Select the SA and Component revisions in the Solution Items. b) Click on More options->Manage->Submit to workflow. c) Select the ""Set in Engineering Workflow"" and then click on Submit. Expected Result a) Selection option will be enabled for Solution Items. b) SA & Component revisions will be selected. c) Submit to Workflow panel will be displayed. b) Engineering workflow will be initiated on selected revision. 18. None Optional: Continuation to step 18 a) Open SA revision and verify Release status in Overview tab. b) Open Component Revision, verify Release status in Overview tab. Expected Result Engineering State should be assigned to the SA/Component revision. 19. None Repeat steps 05-17 for all the Referenced assemblies of the A-Part where it has to be stopped. Win11 - BCS-Snapshot not transferred to Smaragd Erstellt von Sven Gold am 02.05.2025 16:53. Zuletzt geändert von Sven Gold am 03.06.2025 14:38. Artikel hören Description: After Win11 and FileShare Migration users are not signed in anymore with their EMEA or APAC or AMERICAS user account. Therefore the connection to the BCS-Snapshot Transfer Folder can't be created automatically anymore by 4D-Workplace. The folder has to be mapped manually until we have implemented a final fix. See workaround... Workaround: Start ""DriveMappingManager"" on your PC Click on ""Add"" for creating a new network drive mapping Copy ""\\emea.corpdir.net\e019\PRJ\TG\TB-Connect\INT\BCS_Snapshot"" into the field ""Path"" and leave ""Label"" empty Click on ""Save"" Click on ""Apply"" When the Credential Window pops up enter your userid (EMEA or APAC or AMERICAS) and Password - Your old Win10 PC password Click on ""OK"" in ""DriveMappingManager"" 🐞 What was the actual result? (Please, insert screenshots/pictures/logfiles etc. as it is very helpful for us) 🚧 What are the consequences of the incident? Default Platon Incident Template v. 4 from 20.09.2024 .",Dispatcher: Chinmay

349557,PLATON | SendTo Interface PackAssistant | PLMXML format causing plmxml_jt2jt.exe error,"Copied from Repro Steps when changed from Platon Incident to Bug 📍 Location in the Process House (describe, in which part of the process the incident occurs - use Link to navigate) Execution of downloaded SendTo files, after the MidlayerTool starts the SendTo Application for PackAssistant 👉 For incident reproduction: Which action was taken? (Detailed step-by-step description, what you did) SendTo Item for PackAssitant_SteamlineJT was created in Platon Pre03 Part/Assembly A9615050389 was attached to the SendTo Item SendTo Workflow was submitted SendTo Zip-File was downloaded via Download Link (Mail/Notification) MidlayerTool was installed in advance SendTo-File was clicked to start the MidlayerTool MidlayerTool successfully starts PackAssitant_StreamlineJT SendTo application When the SendTo application then trys to start the plmxml_jt2jt.exe, a System.NullReferenceException occurs - probably due to an error in the PLMXML file provided by Platon (converted to Smaragd format) The same SendTo app works finde with the original plmxml file from Smaragd for the same part as input Location of SendTo batchfiles and plmxml_jt2jt.exe : \\emea.corpdir.net\emtc\PRJ\A-D\CAD-Enhancement\EC_SendTo\EcExt\StreamlineJT_PackAssist PLMXML file from Platon and original from Smaragd in attachments 🚩 What was your expected result? The PackAssitant_StreamlineJT SendTo application should be able to successfully pass the plmxml file to the plmxml_jt2jt.exe. After the conversion/merging of the JT-files via plmxml_jt2jt.exe, the JT should then be opened successfully in PackAssistant, showing the geometry and the correct weight of the part. 🐞 What was the actual result? (Please, insert screenshots/pictures/logfiles etc. as it is very helpful for us) Unbehandelte Ausnahme: System.NullReferenceException: Der Objektverweis wurde nicht auf eine Objektinstanz festgelegt. bei plmxml_jt2jt.Module1.Main() This is probably because of the wrong Attributename ""j0CTModSNR"" in the plmxml file - correct would be ""j0CTModSnr"". This was already reported in BUG 315431. When I correct the Attributename in the plmxml file manually, the error does not occur. But then the plmxml_jt2jt.exe is not able to locate the .jt files referenced in the plmxml. In the original Smaragd plmxml we have full paths for all JT-files. In the platon plmxml relative paths are used like: location=""A9603122560\A9603122560_3.jt"" 🚧 What are the consequences of the incident? SendTo Interface from Platon to PackAssistant is not working. No data can be sent from Platon to PackAssistant. Default Platon Incident Template v. 4 from 20.09.2024 .",Dispatcher: Chinmay

Result Title 1. Passed Prerequisites: a) Design revisions with Engineering/Released/Frozen state should be revised to replace Datasets. b) Design revisions with working state can be replaced with new Datasets without revising. c) User should have access to same Project access as in below mentioned Test data. d) Project needs to be part of PDQ Check rule form. e) Supplier JT file must have the Criteria to release with successful Prereleases checks (MODEL Types and Check Results (IO, Warning and Defective). 2. Passed Test Data: BuSc Data 05.25: TT: DMH47X, ARR_PLATON_TEST_MIG_TT, ARR_A4711507286_AU, ARR_A7995400936_KT, ARR_A7755401936_AU MBS: ARR_EPF1094, ARR_TESTLABOR, ARR_PLATON_TESTCASES_ALL_OU TE: ARR01090696, ARR01178194 CTT: USC_136_J_MBMO (j0VwCmp), ARR_PLATON_TEST_MIG_CTT DTNA: ARR DTNA PLATON SAMPLE 2 DICV: ARR_PLATON_TTX_DICV_MIG_TEST, ARR_PLATON_DICV_MIG_TEST FUSO: USCM50A11HG-PLATON BUS: Below can be used present in structure ARR_EPF1094: A0003201989 V5 3D A0004010672 Multiple V5 3D A0004303970 V5 3D plus derived NX (Standard case for Bus legacy data) A0009971371 V5 3D and NX Assembly A0001530353 V4 3D plus derived NX 3. Passed Login to Teamcenter with valid credentials Group: TT/CTT/TE/BUS/DTNA/FUSO/DICV/MBS Role: PDM-Author Expected Result Homepage will be displayed successfully 4. Passed Navigate to Global search and Search for an existing Part having Supplier JT (JT should be on Geometry revision available as Child/Assembly to above Part) Expected Result Part with Supplier JT will be found 5. Passed Select the Part revision and click on New->Revise to revise the existing revision. Note: Parts in Frozen, Engineering/Released state will be revised before performing next steps Expected Result Revise Panel will be displayed 6. Passed Part Number, Revision will be assigned by system and Fill other allowed Details if needed. Click on Save/Revise to complete Revise action. Expected Result New Part revision will be visible in the BoM View/Content tab. 7. Passed a) Select the above Part/Assy revision (Step 06) and Click on Open on Tool bar. b) Navigate to Content tab, Select the Geometry revision and perform Right click->Remove . Expected Result a) Part/Assy revision will be opened. b) Existing Geometry revision will be removed from the structure. 8. Passed a) Select the Part/Assy revision and then click on Add->Child. b) In New, Select the Type as Geometry, then provide Name, Description, No. of elements and other attributes. c) Click on Add. Expected Result a) Add child panel will be displayed. b) Geometry revision will have ID and revision information by default. c) Geometry revision will be added as a child and same Part number from Part/Assy will be assigned to it. 9. Passed a) Select the Geometry revision and Navigate to Attachments tab. b) Click on Add at Files section to link Datasets. c) Click on Select File and Upload a Supplier JT (Direct model) , Type as Direct model , Relation as Rendering. d) Click on Add. Expected Result a) Attachments tab will show Datasets available if any. b, c, d) JT will be linked to the Geometry revision with Specifications relation. 10. Passed Navigate to Overview tab, Click on More commands->Manage->Submit to Workflow->DT- Create derived UGMASTER from JT Expected Result Workflow will be initiated on the Revision 11. Passed Navigate to Workflow tab, Verify the Workflow status in Diagram/Upcoming tasks section Expected Result Workflow status should be Finished. 12. Failed Navigate to Attachments tab, verify the UG master file under Derived files section Expected Result UG Master will be derived with information from the Supplier JT Ex: Weight and Balance properties Comments: No UG Master was created 13. None Navigate to Overview tab , Click on Manage->Submit to Workflow->DT-Create PDQ Batch Expected Result Batch workflow will be triggered on Geometry revision 14. None a) Repeat step 11. b) Navigate to Attachments tab, Select the JT file under Files section and then click on Information on Work area Tool bar. c) Verify if the PDQ Form properties on the information panel are as mentioned below DQ Process status as Engineering/Release Ready DQ Check Seal status as Valid Note: If any of the PDQ checks are failed, they should be corrected and Checks should be initiated again to get valid results Expected Result a) If the workflow is in finished state then proceed to next action b) Information Panel will be displayed. c) PDQ Form should have the values as mentioned. 423431,"Milestone “At Most” allows creating a new Revision between existing released effectivities (and even on the same date), breaking the ascending date chain","Copied from Repro Steps when changed from Platon Incident to Bug Impact: Causes wrong revision to be found/used in production filters Summary Users can create a Milestone and assign it to a newer Revision (0001) of a part with a “Valid from” date that falls between the released effectivity dates of earlier revisions (e.g., between 2024-06-01 of 0001.002 and 2025-09-01 of 0002.001 ). This breaks the ascending effectivity chain and leads to incorrect filter results : searching for a released part valid after the first effectivity returns the milestone-assigned 0001 instead of the actually released 0001.002 . A second edge case exists where the milestone date equals a released revision’s effectivity (e.g., 2025-09-01 ): the system allows assigning a different revision with the same date, creating two competing states on one DMU appointment . Steps to Reproduce Open part e.g. A0134309164 and review released revisions and effectivity dates (as above). Create a Milestone with Valid from = 01.03.2025 12:00:00 (between 2024-06-01 and 2025-09-01). Assign revision 0001 to this milestone. Use “Find part released as of date” (any date ≥ 2024-06-01 and Observe which revision is returned. Edge case (same date): 6. Open part e.g. A9534303464 7. Create a Milestone with Valid from = 01.09.2025 (exactly the same as released 0002.001). 8. Assign a different revision (e.g., 0001) to this milestone. Actual Result Step 5: The search returns 0001 (MSAssigned via milestone) instead of the released revision 0001.002, leading to incorrect usage/selection. Edge case: There are two different revisions on the same DMU appointment date (milestone date = released effectivity), the filter only shows revision 0001 instead of the released 0002.001.",Dispatcher: Chinmay

column1: 354008,A Part / Assembly with different Revisions should not exist in a Flexible Part,"Copied from Repro Steps when changed from Platon Incident to Bug Description: It is currently possible to attach the same Part or Assembly with different revisions under the same Flexible Part. This violates the data integrity rules for Flexible Parts and can lead to inconsistencies in downstream processes like BOM validation, export, or release workflows. Steps to Reproduce : Open a Flexible Part (e.g. A0004286501_FP159) in Teamcenter. Add a Part or Assembly (e.g. A4375000408) twice under the Flexible Part. Revise only one of the instances of A4375000408. Observe that the same Part now exists under the Flexible Part with two different revisions. Expected Behavior : The system should prevent adding multiple revisions of the same Part / Assembly under a single Flexible Part. Once a revision is added, any attempt to add another revision of the same Part number should be blocked with an appropriate error or warning message. Actual Behavior: The system allows the same Part number with different revisions to coexist under the same Flexible Part without any warning or validation error. Screenshot / Evidence :",Dispatcher: Girish

329767,Performance or Stability problem | Very long waiting time for Workset creation,"Copied from Repro Steps when changed from Bug to Platon Incident 👉 Steps to reproduce Open the CTT structure (USC_136_J_MBMO) Use the workset function to create a workset from the whole structure Fill all the mandatory fields Click on create 📜 Session log [Mandatory] 🚩 Expected performance Workset being created and usable with reasonable waiting time (1-5min). Also not having to clear cookies after clicking on ""create"" button. 🐞 Actual performance The worksets take a very long time to get created, and when they are done being created they are not even usable. To clarify : When clicking on the ""create"" button in the workset function the system loads indefinetly. To be able to use the software again we have to clear the cookies of the navigator and look for the newly created workset via the search function. When doing that we have to wait for some time for the workset to be visible in the search results, and even then its content isnt readable (this problem is already reported in incident n°320112). 483945,PLATON sma4u API: /items/files/query does not return P4DCirKit (KBL) datasets,"Problem The PLATON TruckAPI endpoint POST /platon_sma4u/v1/items/files/query does not return KBL files stored as P4DCirKit (Circuit Kit) datasets. This blocks any partner system using the TruckAPI from downloading KBL files programmatically for HKH parts. Background Per ADO #340329 (FM | Change mapping for Migration of kbl files as P4DCirKit, state: DOD), KBL files were intentionally re-mapped to the P4DCirKit dataset type during SMARAGD migration, based on file attributes RelativePath / WorkingRelativePath / j0OriginalFileName ending in .kbl. The TruckAPI was not updated to reflect this new dataset structure. Per ADO #414169 (SendToKBLViewer, state: New), KBL files must be identifiable via P4DCirKit alone (extension can be .xml or .kbl for legacy/migrated data, .kbl for PLATON native data). This is the authoritative identification path -- not the file extension. Detailed Evidence (production, part HKH666821T026) TC object model (from AWC browser session HAR analysis) P4DDesignRevision (HKH666821T026, UID: UZDzUvdgPFswlD) -> IMAN_specification -> UGMASTER (HKH666821T026.prt, UID: 0P31BGiyPFcXwC) -- returned by TruckAPI, no KBL here -> [not exposed via TruckAPI] -> P4DCirKit (HKH666821T026_0001.06, UID: SgzlQ3w6PFc5EA) -> ref_list -> ImanFile: HKH666821T026_0001_06.kbl (UID: EwHZpRYBPF8jdA) TruckAPI calls tested (all failed to return KBL) GET /gen/relations?p4d_part_number=HKH666821T026 -- returns only UGMASTER (.prt) and P4DDesignRevisionMaster
column2: P4DCirKit not visible POST /items/files/query with relation_type: IMAN_specification, IMAN_Rendering, TC_Attaches, IMAN_reference, CMHasSolutionItem, IMAN_UG_altrep -- none return the KBL POST /items/files/query with derived_files=true -- returns only technologydata.xml (Collector, NX port data)
column3: not the KBL POST /items/files/query with dataset_uid=UGMASTER-UID and derived_files=true -- same result, no KBL How AWC frontend retrieves the KBL (for reference) AWC calls getDeclarativeStyleSheets for the P4DDesignRevision -> finds P4DCirKit tab with ref_list -> calls getFileReadTickets with ImanFile UID EwHZpRYBPF8jdA directly. This TC SOA path is not available via TruckAPI. Expected Behavior POST /items/files/query for an HKH part number must also traverse and return files attached via P4DCirKit datasets. The response entry should include original_file_name, original_file_ext, and a valid FMS download ticket -- consistent with what the AWC frontend already shows and with ADO #414169 requirements. Scope of Impact All HKH parts whose KBL was migrated from SMARAGD as P4DCirKit (per ADO #340329) are affected. This is not limited to PREEvision -- any partner system using /items/files/query to retrieve KBL files is impacted. Workaround None available via TruckAPI. Direct TC SOA session (browser SSO) is the only current path to retrieve the KBL, which is not feasible for automated/headless systems. Reported by Petzsche, Christian (028) -- PEER team, Daimler Buses. Contact via JIRA DBPREE-818.",BUS
